components.name: Aurelia / Aurelia+ shared video controller

implementation_design.status: Accepted design baseline; electrical timing, layout, fabrication and monitor qualification remain pending.
implementation_design.arbitration: Independent display-DRAM and sprite-SRAM buses. Display reads and full-array refresh have bounded host/DMA backpressure. Sprite fetches use the separate SRAM bus and existing staging/shifters; completed FIFO banks preserve raster order.
implementation_design.text_fetch: Cache 80 character codes and 80 attributes; prefetch the next row into the second 160-byte cache over eight glyph scanlines. Expand each glyph byte to eight 4-bit pixels; prefetch sprite rows and apply fixed priority before publishing pixels.
implementation_design.line_repeat: Re-fetch repeated bitmap lines; FIFO capacity is not an additional framebuffer or guaranteed retained scanline. Validate 320x100x4 bandwidth and refresh at the selected DRAM grade.

clock_targets.scope: 14.31818 MHz short scanout/counter path; renderer uses block expansion and clock enables, not a full CPU at pixel rate. Process-corner qualification required.

manufacturing_planning.status: Engineering estimates, not measured yields or released costs.
manufacturing_planning.process: 3–3.5 micron NMOS; laser-written process-matched masks from secret facility; wafer fabrication at AION Labs.
manufacturing_planning.yield_note: 3 micron planning model: 0.85*exp(-2.8*area_mm2/100), then 0.93 package/test yield. 52 mm2 central die; speed-bin and pinout qualification pending.
external_functions: Two AION 2114-equivalent SRAM chips on a separate sprite bus; enlarged interface package/PCB allowance costed at assembly level

engines.renderer: Dedicated fetch/address, eight-pixel glyph expansion, colour selection and fixed-priority sprite compositor; not a general-purpose CPU. Runs when a free FIFO bank and source data are available.
engines.scanout: Independent fixed-raster sequencer reads completed 4-bit pixels and generates sync. Both engines use the same master clock with clock enables.
engines.fifo: Four 40-byte addressed banks with output latches; ordered circular FREE/FILLING/READY/READING ownership. Publish complete banks only; backpressure on full FIFO; prefill before active display.
engines.underrun: Continue sync, emit border colour and latch diagnostic status; never read a partially rendered bank.

timing_budget.status: Analytical planning bounds only; not a cycle-accurate proof.
timing_budget.qualification: 100 display-DRAM reads average 37.5 us; 40 sprite bytes take 10 us on a separate bus. Descriptor reads and row transitions also need scheduling. Prove local FIFO deadlines, refresh, repeated bitmap lines and uploads; these averages are not a timing proof.

implementation_design.sprite_access: Two AION 2114-equivalent chips form an exclusive 1 KiB 8-bit SRAM bank. Auto-increment upload ports arbitrate CPU/DMA writes against sprite reads; descriptor-bank selection latches at vertical blank.

pixel_buffer.policy: FREE/FILLING/READY/READING banks; output latches and serializer. Never overwrite active bank; underrun preserves sync.

components.name: AION Artemis buffered video controller

specification.mode_discovery: Enumerate controller modes intersected with identified or configured monitor raster capabilities and available buffering/sprite allocations. Reject unsupported downscaling.

memory_layout.mode_exclusivity: Text/font and bitmap allocations are alternative uses of 32 KiB display DRAM. Exclusive 1 KiB sprite SRAM is available in every mode.
memory_layout.font_policy: One shared 256-glyph bank per mode. Font allocation 2048 bytes at 8×8, 4096 at 8×16 or 8×10 (16-byte glyph stride). Font writes affect both pages.
memory_layout.page_flip: Latch selected page during vertical blank; drawing throughput is not guaranteed by double buffering.

sprites.coordinate_space: Logical mode pixels; scale together with the background. Signed 16-bit X and Y; clip at screen edges.
sprites.priority: Lower sprite number wins; all sprites overlay background/text.
sprites.registers: Two descriptor banks hold signed 16-bit X/Y, enable and reserved controls. CPU/DMA uses auto-incrementing SRAM upload ports.
sprites.updates: Switch descriptor bank atomically at vertical blank. Pattern writes require scheduled access or disabling affected sprites; 1 KiB does not hold two complete pattern sets.
sprites.allocation_policy: Five sprites in every text/bitmap mode, including double-buffered backgrounds. Sprite SRAM never consumes display DRAM.
sprites.descriptor_allocation_note: 80 bytes of live two-bank descriptors within a 128-byte reserved area; 48 bytes padding. 640 pattern + 128 descriptor + 256 scratch bytes = 1024.

display_memory.organization: 16K × 16 bits; ordinary external DRAM, independent display refresh sequencer.

pixel_buffer.location: On video ASIC; SRAM banks with page ownership latches
pixel_buffer.policy: Eight-pixel parallel renderer fills free pages; independent clocked serializer drains ready pages. Two pages per 640-pixel line; prefill before active display; never overwrite displaying pages. Underflow blanks pixels, preserves sync and sets sticky fault.
pixel_buffer.physical_organization: Each 160-byte bank is 40 words × 32 bits. Load eight 4-bit pixels into a separate 32-bit serializer latch every eight dot clocks, then shift at 21.504 MHz. SRAM array reads run at 2.688 MHz, not one read per dot; filler and drain use different banks.

character_row_cache.purpose: Current and next 80-column character/attribute row; separate from 640-byte pixel FIFO.

timing_budget.qualification: At 250 ns conservative DRAM cycle, 80 glyph fetches consume 20 microseconds per active line; 160-byte row prefetch amortizes across 8/10/16 scanlines. Two row caches and 16-bit reads cover text-row transitions. Verify sprites, refresh and bounded host/DMA slots together at voltage/temperature corners; no guaranteed maximum CPU upload rate.

specification.arbitration: Card-local sequencer arbitrates display fetch and deadline-reserved independent DRAM refresh before bounded host/DMA transfers with READY. Sprite SRAM has its own 8-bit bus. System DMA/MMU remain dedicated host components; the card does not replace system-memory refresh.
specification.monitor_policy: Read capability descriptor before enabling sync. Mono Pro accepts only raster_640_400; integer-scale legacy modes. Old monitors retain their advertised 200-line raster(s), never 640×400. Native 400-line modes require Mono Pro; new 200-line bitmap modes also work on capable older displays. This is display-mode/API compatibility, not Z80 binary compatibility.
